bio.text: Casey Askar is the Republican nominee for Florida's 22nd Congressional District in the November 3, 2026 general election, having advanced from the August 18 primary.
According to his Ballotpedia survey, he came to the United States from Iraq with his parents at age 7 and joined the U.S. Marine Corps at 18.
The survey says he is a businessman and one of the largest franchisees of brands such as Church's Chicken and Dunkin', and that he has six children.
